method: direct Pavo calls (0 credits) on the same Keeper line, each clip checked with lipsync_check.py

measurements.prompt: calibration ("Image 1 is the narrator: ... He looks straight into the camera and speaks the words of the audio clip, his lips moving in sync with the voice ...")
plan k-insight + "Image 1 is the narrator:" + "speaks the words of the audio clip, his lips moving in sync with the voice"
same, WAV padded with silence to 10 s

conclusions: Pavo keeps our input audio only when the clip asked for is at most ~0.65 s longer than the speech; at 1.6 s or more it makes its own track (not a uniform time-stretch)
the prompt must bind the reference and the audio: "Image 1 is <the speaker>" and "speaks the words of the audio clip, his lips moving in sync with the voice"
the approved mouth-closed, tightly framed front reference breaks the lip tracking; the speaking frame of the Keeper's own reviewed calibration clip passes
rules: plan_check TALK_CLIP 4-12 s, TALK_PAD 0.25-0.65 s, retime to N - 0.45 s within +-10 %, hold <= 1.3 s; episode_build bind_prompt and the `talk_refs` reference
